body:
# 🏃‍♂️ Drag Queen 🏃‍♂️

Master friction and drag in the world, by not experiencing it at all. All the mobs are also drag queens.

Really good features:

- 🧊 Ground friction removed
- 💨 Air drag removed
- 💧 Water drag removed
- 🔥 Lava drag removed
- 👼 Elytra drag removed (insane swoops)
- 🚀 Firework rocket boost speed limit removed (reworked mechanics quite a bit)
- Nothing actually related to the art of drag lol sorry for clickbait

Meant to be used with [typical speedrunning mods](https://mods.tildejustin.dev/) on 1.16.1, use on other versions and mod combinations at your own risk.

⚠ This mod will change your movement on servers, so you will probably trigger their anti-cheats and get banned. Do not use this mod on servers that don't also have the mod! ⚠
